questions.solution_html:

questions.question: Explain the role of the default case in a switch structure. Explain with example.
questions.solution_html:
• The default case executes when none of the cases match the expression value.
  • int day=8;
  • switch(day){
  • case 1
  • System.out.println("Monday");
  • break;
  • default
  • System.out.println("Invalid Day");
  • }
  • Importance
  •  Handles unexpected inputs.
  •  Improves program reliability.
